The '''Observatory'''<ref name="Faraway-''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #37''">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor37.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #37''}}</ref> was a former solar observatory which the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] criminal [[Nunk Plaarvin]] used as a negotiation room on [[Metellos 3]], which he used as his base of operations.

==History==
Once the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] choose to redirect funding to the [[Flashpoint Stellar Research Station]], the Metellos observatory became abandoned. Initially the Observatory, notable for its collection of telescopic devices, had attracted only academics and occasional tourists trying to escape the overcrowded [[Planet/Legends|planet]] below. But when the exploration of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] began anew after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], locals discovered that they could use the devices to discover and explore new astronomical bodies.

With the co-operation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Metellos 3 became the first of several "[[planetary futures exchange]]s", offering the rights to the newly discovered astronomical objects. Since expeditions to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds were quite expensive, the investors wanted to know the risk and potential reward in advance. The [[Metellos Exchange]] provided this information, based on the astronomical data gathered, and then auctioned the claims. The Exchange itself however, was affiliated with the [[Raff Syndicate]], an organization criminal by it's nature. It's people legally got a piece of every transition on the market, only people kept showing up with various counterclaims. So they pretended to pay them to go away, while sending them to the Observatory at the top of the tower instead. The glass in the Observatory was meant to magnify and increase the intensity of Metellos's already powerful sunlight and incinerate anyone in the room. [[Rohlan Dyre]] and [[Jarael]] were the only known individuals to escape the room alive, due to Jarael using her latent [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]].
